calls.title: Quick Forecast Walk Through
calls.summary: The team agreed to implement a quarterly forecasting process using HubSpot, allowing reps to manually input and adjust forecast amounts alongside detailed notes. Jeff enabled submission and edit access for reps, who are encouraged to provide total quarterly forecasts rather than deal-by-deal rollups. Ryan clarified forecasting categories and proposed manual overrides to streamline inputs. Ongoing challenges with renewal data cleanup were discussed, with Jeff reporting only 10% completion on this task. The interim guidance instructs reps to include only incremental expansions in their forecasts, while a phased approach will be adopted for future automation of renewal forecasting. The meeting also highlighted the need for a hybrid inspection strategy, combining manual inputs with MEDDIC fields to enhance accuracy and context for deal health, along with potential custom integrations for improved forecasting tools.
calls.keywords: Forecasting, HubSpot, Sales Pipeline, Commit Amount, Renewal Expansion, MEDPIC Criteria
